localized_zstd_link.method: Build bundled Zstd with production visibility definitions and -fvisibility=hidden; ld -r; objcopy --localize-hidden; assert public ObZstdWrapper symbols remain and raw ZSTD_compressCCtx is not global; link codec test against localized object and run.
localized_zstd_link.script:
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
build = root / 'release'
objects = sorted((build / 'CMakeFiles/cuvs_test_zstd.dir').rglob('*.o'))
assert objects

def run(args):
    args = list(map(str, args))
    print('$ ' + shlex.join(args), flush=True)
    subprocess.run(args, check=True)

run(['ld', '-r', *objects, '-o', build / 'zstd.tmp.o'])
run(['objcopy', '--localize-hidden', build / 'zstd.tmp.o', build / 'zstd.local.o'])
symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-g', '-C', '--defined-only', str(build / 'zstd.local.o')], text=True)
assert 'ObZstdWrapper::compress(' in symbols
assert 'ObZstdWrapper::decompress(' in symbols
assert ' T ZSTD_compressCCtx' not in symbols
run(['g++', '-std=c++17', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-I' + str(root / 'src/oblib'),
     root / 'unittest/oblib/vector/cuvs/test_cuvs_snapshot_codec.cpp', build / 'zstd.local.o',
     '-pthread', '-o', build / 'codec_localized'])
run([build / 'codec_localized'])
print('PASS: codec links and runs after production-style hidden symbol localization', flush=True)
